snippet.title: Haunting of Mageburrow: A Cozy Lovecraftian Horror RPG - Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for the new Solohack3r Studios horror RPG, Haunting of Mageburrow.

Become a paranormal investigator & explore an open world. Solve a criminal conspiracy of the occult. Inspired by Lovecraftian horror.

Check it out on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4292190/Haunting_of_Mageburrow/
